AlberdiLab | Functional phylosymbiosis Testing functional phylosymbiosis in EHI data Irene Martínez, M Thomas P Gilbert, Antton Alberdi1 Last update: 2026-11-20 Chapter 1 Introduction This webbook contains all the code used for data analysis for testing functional phylosymbiosis in Earth Hologenome Initiative data. 1.1 Prepare the R environment 1.1.1 Environment To reproduce all the analyses locally, clone this repository in your computer using: RStudio > New Project > Version Control > Git And indicating the following git repository: https://github.com/irene-martinez-garcia/testing_functional_phylosymbiosis_ehi.git Once the R project has been created, follow the instructions and code chunks shown in this webbook. 1.1.2 Libraries The following R packages are required for the data analysis. library(R.utils) #library(knitr) #library(tidyverse) #library(ape) #library(vegan) University of Copenhagen, antton.alberdi@sund.ku.dk↩︎
